This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 2026-05-07 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Nordiska Verktyg AB, with its registered office at Kungsgatan 8, Göteborg
("Party A"), and Svea Logistik AB, with its registered office at Industrivägen 3, Stockholm ("Party
B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 36 months from the Effective Date unless
terminated earlier in accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall
use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by Swedish law.
